description: Dataset for Physics informed Ensemble Learning in Power System Security Assessment is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Hongru Wang. This dataset includes two files: the "operation status 1" records the power system operates on most secure occasions. And the "operation status 2" records the power system handles insecure events. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
